mapper.select: SELECT rownum SEQ_NO,t.* from (select ENTRUST_ID, OPER_TYPE, to_char(OPER_DATE,'yyyy-MM-dd') OPER_DATE, to_char(OPER_TIME,'hh24:mi:ss') OPER_TIME, BUSI_DES, real_name userId from ETR_ENTRUST_OPER_HIS LEFT JOIN SYS_USER SU on ETR_ENTRUST_OPER_HIS.user_id = SU.user_name WHERE entrust_id = #{entrustId} order by OPER_TIME desc) t

SELECT rit.sup_stat supStat, rii.ind_name indName, rii.ind_type indType, pp.portfolio_name portfolioName, fp.finprod_abbr finprodAbbr, rit.warn_cond warnCond, rit.approve_cond approveCond, rit.foul_cond foulCond, rit.sup_val supVal, rit.old_sup_val oldSupVal, rit.sup_trend supTrend FROM RSK_ISUP_TRIAL rit INNER JOIN RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR rii ON rit.ind_id = rii.ind_id LEFT JOIN ptl_portfolio pp ON rit.portfolio_id = pp.portfolio_id LEFT JOIN fin_product fp ON rit.asset_code = fp.finprod_id WHERE rit.trade_id = #{entrustId} AND rit.conclusion is null

select T2.ASSIGNEE_ hiUser, T2.TASK_DEF_KEY_ nodeId, T2.NAME_ nodeName, NVL(T2.END_TIME_, T2.CLAIM_TIME_) operTime from SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST T1 left join ACT_HI_TASKINST T2 on T1.workflow_id=T2.PROC_INST_ID_ left join ACT_HI_COMMENT T3 ON T3.TASK_ID_ = T2.ID_ AND T3.PROC_INST_ID_ = T2.PROC_INST_ID_ AND T3.USER_ID_ = T2.ASSIGNEE_ where T1.TRADE_ID= #{busiCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
